description: Test suite for LaunchAgentManager, verifying plist content and behavior related to Launch Agents on macOS.

classes.name: LaunchAgentManagerTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests verifying the correct generation of launch agent plist files and their contents.

methods.name: `launch at login plist does not keep app alive after manual quit`
methods.description: Tests that the generated plist has 'RunAtLoad' set to true and 'KeepAlive' set to nil, and that the 'ProgramArguments' are correctly set.
